title: Correct final speed
description: Essential: The response must state the correct numerical speed (14 m/s) for the object at the fifth-floor rooftop.

title: Correct floor number
description: Essential: The response must state the correct floor number (9) from which the object was thrown.

title: Uses correct kinematic equation
description: Important: The solution must apply the correct kinematic equation (e.g., h = vt + 1/2 gt^2) to find the speed at the rooftop.

title: Calculates drop height
description: Important: The solution must correctly use v^2 = 2gΔh (or equivalent) to find the drop height above the fifth floor.

title: Converts height to floors
description: Important: The solution must correctly add the 5 floors and divide the additional drop height by the floor height (3 m) to determine the total floor number.

title: Proper rounding
description: Optional: The solution should correctly round the calculated total floor number to the nearest whole number (or justify the floor assignment).

title: Sign error in equation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the sign for acceleration (g) is incorrect in the kinematic equations, leading to a wrong speed or height.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if units are missing, incorrectly used, or inconsistent in calculations (e.g., mixing m and cm, or m/s^2 not used correctly).
